```{r data-setup}
Data_all <- read_excel("~/Consulting/3_Data.xlsx")
CE0_group <- as.numeric(as.character(Data_all$CE0))

Data_allinput <- Data_all %>%
  select(
    "CP_WB1","CP_WB2","CP_WB3","CP_WB4",
    "CP_A1","CP_A2","CP_A3",
    "TC1_DamagedArea","TC2_EconomicLoss",
    "IC1","IC2_1","IC2_2","IC2_3","IC2_DescriptiveAttitude",
    "IB","Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol3_1","Tol4_5",
    "PE","CE0","CE1","CE2","CA1","CA2","CA3","PS1","PS2",
    "Q4_Gender","Q5_Age","Q6_Education","Q8_AnnualIncome",
    "Q14_HouseholdAsset","Q14_CropAsset"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
  scale() %>%
  as.data.frame()

Data_comp   <- Data_allinput[CE0_group == 1, ]
Data_nocomp <- Data_allinput[CE0_group == 0, ]
n_comp      <- nrow(Data_comp)
n_nocomp    <- nrow(Data_nocomp)
```

```{r helper-functions}
get_path_info <- function(boot_summary, from, to) {
  row_label <- paste0(from, "  ->  ", to)
  tryCatch({
    b  <- boot_summary$bootstrapped_paths[row_label, "Original Est."]
    lo <- boot_summary$bootstrapped_paths[row_label, "2.5% CI"]
    hi <- boot_summary$bootstrapped_paths[row_label, "97.5% CI"]
    data.frame(beta = b, ci_low = lo, ci_high = hi)
  }, error = function(e) data.frame(beta = NA, ci_low = NA, ci_high = NA))
}

get_r2 <- function(pls_model) {
  tryCatch({
    as.numeric(summary(pls_model)$paths["R^2", "Tolerance"])
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

get_srmr <- function(pls_model) {
  tryCatch({
    scores  <- as.data.frame(pls_model$construct_scores)
    obs_cor <- cor(scores)
    paths   <- pls_model$path_coef
    implied <- paths %*% cor(scores) %*% t(paths)
    diag(implied) <- 1
    residuals <- obs_cor - implied
    round(sqrt(mean(residuals[lower.tri(residuals)]^2)), 4)
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

get_f2_tol <- function(pls_model) {
  tryCatch({
    s      <- summary(pls_model)
    f2_mat <- s$fSquare
    if (!is.null(f2_mat) && "Tolerance" %in% colnames(f2_mat)) {
      vals <- f2_mat[, "Tolerance"]
      round(vals[!is.na(vals) & vals > 0], 3)
    } else NA
  }, error = function(e) NA)
}

get_htmt_tol <- function(pls_model) {
  tryCatch({
    s    <- summary(pls_model)
    htmt <- s$validity$htmt
    if (is.null(htmt)) return(NULL)
    df <- as.data.frame(htmt)
    df$From <- rownames(df)
    df %>%
      select(From, Tolerance) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Tolerance) & Tolerance > 0) %>%
      mutate(
        Tolerance = round(Tolerance, 3),
        Flag      = case_when(
          Tolerance > 1.0  ~ "Violation (>1.00)",
          Tolerance > 0.85 ~ "Concern (>0.85)",
          TRUE             ~ "OK (<0.85)"
        )
      )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}
```

```{r baseline-model}
mm_base <- constructs(
  composite("ConflictExp_WB",   c("CP_WB1","CP_WB2","CP_WB4"),          weights = mode_B),
  composite("ConflictExp_A",    c("CP_A1","CP_A2","CP_A3"),             weights = mode_B),
  composite("Policy_Support",   c("PS1","PS2"),                          weights = mode_B),
  composite("Tangible_Costs",   c("TC1_DamagedArea","TC2_EconomicLoss"), weights = mode_B),
  composite("Intangible_Costs", c("IC1","IC2_1","IC2_2"),               weights = mode_B),
  reflective("Prevention_Effectiveness",  "PE"),
  reflective("Compensation_Experience",   "CE0"),
  reflective("Compensation_Anticipation", "CA3"),
  reflective("Intangible_Benefits",       "IB"),
  reflective("Gender",         "Q4_Gender"),
  reflective("Age",            "Q5_Age"),
  reflective("Education",      "Q6_Education"),
  reflective("AnnualIncome",   "Q8_AnnualIncome"),
  reflective("HouseholdAsset", "Q14_CropAsset"),
  reflective("Tolerance",      c("Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol4_5"))
)

sm_base <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A"),
        to   = c("Prevention_Effectiveness","Compensation_Experience",
                 "Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Experience","Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support"),
        to   = c("Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Experience","Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support",
                 "Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits",
                 "Gender","Age","Education","AnnualIncome","HouseholdAsset"),
        to   = "Tolerance")
)

pls_base      <- estimate_pls(Data_allinput, mm_base, sm_base, inner_weights = path_weighting)
sum_base      <- summary(pls_base)
boot_base     <- bootstrap_model(pls_base, nboot = 1000, seed = 42)
sum_boot_base <- summary(boot_base, alpha = 0.05)
```

```{r item-quality}
loadings_df <- as.data.frame(sum_base$loadings) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Item") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Item, names_to = "Construct", values_to = "Loading") %>%
  filter(abs(Loading) > 0.001) %>%
  mutate(
    Loading = round(Loading, 3),
    Flag    = case_when(
      abs(Loading) >= 0.70 ~ "Good (>=0.70)",
      abs(Loading) >= 0.40 ~ "Moderate (0.40–0.70)",
      TRUE                 ~ "Low (<0.40) — drop"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Construct %in% c("Tolerance","Intangible_Benefits",
                           "Prevention_Effectiveness","Compensation_Experience",
                           "Compensation_Anticipation")) %>%
  arrange(Construct, desc(abs(Loading)))

vif_df <- lapply(names(sum_base$validity$vif_items), function(construct) {
  v <- sum_base$validity$vif_items[[construct]]
  if (length(v) > 1) {
    data.frame(
      Construct = construct,
      Item      = names(v),
      VIF       = round(as.numeric(v), 3),
      Flag      = ifelse(as.numeric(v) > 5, "High (>5)",
                  ifelse(as.numeric(v) > 3, "Moderate (3–5)", "OK (<3)"))
    )
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

# Section 5 — Robustness Checks

## Outer Loadings — Reflective Constructs

```{r table-loadings}
loadings_df %>%
  select(Construct, Item, Loading, Flag) %>%
  rename("Outer Loading" = Loading, "Assessment" = Flag) %>%
  kable(align = "llrl") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 13, full_width = TRUE,
                bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(loadings_df$Flag == "Good (>=0.70)"),    color = "#27ae60") %>%
  row_spec(which(grepl("Moderate", loadings_df$Flag)),     color = "#e67e22", bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(loadings_df$Flag == "Low (<0.40) — drop"), color = "#c0392b", bold = TRUE)
```

## VIF — Formative Constructs

```{r table-vif}
vif_df %>%
  rename("Assessment" = Flag) %>%
  kable(align = "llrl") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 13, full_width = TRUE,
                bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(vif_df$Flag == "OK (<3)"),             color = "#27ae60") %>%
  row_spec(which(vif_df$Flag == "Moderate (3–5)"),       color = "#e67e22", bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(vif_df$Flag == "High (>5)"),            color = "#c0392b", bold = TRUE)
```

```{r table-specs}
robustness_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(beta, ci_low, ci_high), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  rename("β" = beta, "95% CI lower" = ci_low, "95% CI upper" = ci_high) %>%
  kable(align = "lrrr") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r table-r2-srmr}
  mutate(SRMR_flag = case_when(

    SRMR < 0.08 ~ paste0(SRMR, " ✓"),

  )) %>%
```

## VoE — Full Vibration of Effects

```{r voe-full, cache=TRUE}
cs <- as.data.frame(pls_base$construct_scores)

adjustments <- c(
  "ConflictExp_WB", "ConflictExp_A",
  "Prevention_Effectiveness", "Compensation_Anticipation",
  "Policy_Support", "Tangible_Costs",
  "Intangible_Costs", "Intangible_Benefits",
  "Gender", "Age", "Education",
  "AnnualIncome", "HouseholdAsset"
)

n_adj        <- length(adjustments)
n_models     <- 2^n_adj
combo_matrix <- do.call(expand.grid, replicate(n_adj, 0:1, simplify = FALSE))
colnames(combo_matrix) <- adjustments

set.seed(42)
voe_results <- vector("list", n_models)

for (i in seq_len(n_models)) {
  included <- adjustments[as.logical(combo_matrix[i, ])]
  k <- length(included)
  fmla <- if (k == 0) {
    as.formula("Tolerance ~ Compensation_Experience")
  } else {
    as.formula(paste("Tolerance ~ Compensation_Experience +",
                     paste(included, collapse = " + ")))
  }
  fit <- tryCatch(lm(fmla, data = cs), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    coefs  <- broom::tidy(fit)
    ce_row <- coefs[coefs$term == "Compensation_Experience", ]
    if (nrow(ce_row) == 1) {
      voe_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
        model_id    = i,
        k           = k,
        beta        = ce_row$estimate,
        se          = ce_row$std.error,
        p_value     = ce_row$p.value,
        neg_log10_p = -log10(ce_row$p.value)
      )
    }
  }
}

voe_df        <- bind_rows(voe_results)
beta_p01      <- quantile(voe_df$beta, 0.01)
beta_p50      <- quantile(voe_df$beta, 0.50)
beta_p99      <- quantile(voe_df$beta, 0.99)
voe_spread    <- round(beta_p99 - beta_p01, 4)
prop_negative <- round(mean(voe_df$beta < 0), 3)
prop_sig      <- round(mean(voe_df$p_value < 0.05), 3)
janus         <- beta_p01 < 0 & beta_p99 > 0
```

### VoE Summary Statistics

```{r table-voe-summary}
data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total models estimated",
    "Median β (Compensation Experience → Tolerance)",
    "1st percentile β",
    "99th percentile β",
    "Spread (99th − 1st percentile)",
    "% of models with negative β",
    "% of models with p < .05",
    "Janus effect (sign flip)?"
  ),
  Value = c(
    formatC(nrow(voe_df), format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    round(beta_p50, 4),
    round(beta_p01, 4),
    round(beta_p99, 4),
    round(voe_spread, 4),
    paste0(round(prop_negative * 100, 1), "%"),
    paste0(round(prop_sig * 100, 1), "%"),
    ifelse(janus, "Yes — Janus effect present", "No — sign stable across all models")
  )
) %>%
  kable(align = "lr", col.names = c("Metric", "Value")) %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(8, bold = TRUE,
           color = ifelse(janus, "#c0392b", "#27ae60"))
```

# Section 6 — Multi-Group Analysis

```{r mga-estimation}
mm_mga <- constructs(
  composite("ConflictExp_WB",   c("CP_WB1","CP_WB2","CP_WB4"),          weights = mode_B),
  composite("ConflictExp_A",    c("CP_A1","CP_A2","CP_A3"),             weights = mode_B),
  composite("Policy_Support",   c("PS1","PS2"),                          weights = mode_B),
  composite("Tangible_Costs",   c("TC1_DamagedArea","TC2_EconomicLoss"), weights = mode_B),
  composite("Intangible_Costs", c("IC1","IC2_1","IC2_2"),               weights = mode_B),
  reflective("Prevention_Effectiveness",  "PE"),
  reflective("Compensation_Anticipation", "CA3"),
  reflective("Intangible_Benefits",       "IB"),
  reflective("Gender",         "Q4_Gender"),
  reflective("Age",            "Q5_Age"),
  reflective("Education",      "Q6_Education"),
  reflective("AnnualIncome",   "Q8_AnnualIncome"),
  reflective("HouseholdAsset", "Q14_CropAsset"),
  reflective("Tolerance",      c("Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol4_5"))
)
sm_mga <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A"),
        to   = c("Prevention_Effectiveness","Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support"),
        to   = c("Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support",
                 "Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits",
                 "Gender","Age","Education","AnnualIncome","HouseholdAsset"),
        to   = "Tolerance")
)

mm_mga2 <- constructs(
  composite("ConflictExp_WB",            c("CP_WB1","CP_WB2","CP_WB4"),          weights = mode_B),
  reflective("ConflictExp_A",            "CP_A1"),
  reflective("Prevention_Effectiveness", "PE"),
  reflective("Compensation_Anticipation","CA3"),
  composite("Policy_Support",            c("PS1","PS2"),                          weights = mode_B),
  composite("Tangible_Costs",            c("TC1_DamagedArea","TC2_EconomicLoss"), weights = mode_B),
  reflective("Intangible_Costs",         "IC1"),
  reflective("Intangible_Benefits",      "IB"),
  reflective("Tolerance",                c("Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol4_5"))
)
sm_mga2 <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A"),
        to   = c("Prevention_Effectiveness","Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support"),
        to   = c("Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits")),
  paths(from = c("ConflictExp_WB","ConflictExp_A","Prevention_Effectiveness",
                 "Compensation_Anticipation","Policy_Support",
                 "Tangible_Costs","Intangible_Costs","Intangible_Benefits"),
        to   = "Tolerance")
)

pls_comp    <- estimate_pls(Data_comp,   mm_mga,  sm_mga,  inner_weights = path_weighting)
pls_nocomp  <- estimate_pls(Data_nocomp, mm_mga,  sm_mga,  inner_weights = path_weighting)
pls_comp2   <- estimate_pls(Data_comp,   mm_mga2, sm_mga2, inner_weights = path_weighting)
pls_nocomp2 <- estimate_pls(Data_nocomp, mm_mga2, sm_mga2, inner_weights = path_weighting)

predictors_to_tol  <- rownames(pls_comp$path_coef)[rownames(pls_comp$path_coef)  != "Tolerance"]
predictors_to_tol2 <- rownames(pls_comp2$path_coef)[rownames(pls_comp2$path_coef) != "Tolerance"]

set.seed(123)
boot_comp        <- bootstrap_model(pls_comp,    nboot = 1000)
boot_nocomp      <- bootstrap_model(pls_nocomp,  nboot = 1000)
boot_comp2       <- bootstrap_model(pls_comp2,   nboot = 1000)
boot_nocomp2     <- bootstrap_model(pls_nocomp2, nboot = 1000)
boot_comp_sum    <- summary(boot_comp,    alpha = 0.05)
boot_nocomp_sum  <- summary(boot_nocomp,  alpha = 0.05)
boot_comp_sum2   <- summary(boot_comp2,   alpha = 0.05)
boot_nocomp_sum2 <- summary(boot_nocomp2, alpha = 0.05)

run_permutation_mga <- function(pls_c, pls_n, mm, sm, predictors, n_c, n_n) {
  obs_c    <- pls_c$path_coef[predictors, "Tolerance"]
  obs_n    <- pls_n$path_coef[predictors, "Tolerance"]
  obs_diff <- obs_c - obs_n
  Data_comb  <- rbind(Data_comp, Data_nocomp)
  grp_labels <- c(rep(1, n_c), rep(0, n_n))
  set.seed(42)
  perm_diffs <- replicate(1000, {
    pl <- sample(grp_labels)
    dc <- Data_comb[pl == 1, ]
    dn <- Data_comb[pl == 0, ]
    mc <- tryCatch(estimate_pls(dc, mm, sm, inner_weights = path_weighting), error = function(e) NULL)
    mn <- tryCatch(estimate_pls(dn, mm, sm, inner_weights = path_weighting), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(mc) | is.null(mn)) return(rep(NA, length(predictors)))
    mc$path_coef[predictors, "Tolerance"] - mn$path_coef[predictors, "Tolerance"]
  })
  p_vals <- sapply(seq_along(predictors), function(i) {
    nd <- na.omit(perm_diffs[i, ])
    mean(abs(nd) >= abs(obs_diff[i]))
  })
  data.frame(
    Predictor   = predictors,
    Beta_comp   = round(obs_c,    3),
    Beta_nocomp = round(obs_n,    3),
    Delta       = round(obs_diff, 3),
    p_value     = round(p_vals,   3),
    Significant = ifelse(p_vals < 0.05, "Yes *", "No")
  )
}

mga_df  <- run_permutation_mga(pls_comp,  pls_nocomp,  mm_mga,  sm_mga,
                                predictors_to_tol,  n_comp, n_nocomp)
mga_df2 <- run_permutation_mga(pls_comp2, pls_nocomp2, mm_mga2, sm_mga2,
                                predictors_to_tol2, n_comp, n_nocomp)

build_f2_table <- function(f2_comp, f2_nocomp) {
  common <- intersect(names(f2_comp), names(f2_nocomp))
  if (length(common) == 0) return(data.frame(Note = "f² not available"))
  data.frame(
    Predictor    = str_replace_all(common, "_", " "),
    f2_with      = f2_comp[common],
    f2_without   = f2_nocomp[common],
    Size_with    = case_when(f2_comp[common] >= 0.35 ~ "Large",
                              f2_comp[common] >= 0.15 ~ "Medium",
                              f2_comp[common] >= 0.02 ~ "Small",
                              TRUE ~ "Negligible"),
    Size_without = case_when(f2_nocomp[common] >= 0.35 ~ "Large",
                              f2_nocomp[common] >= 0.15 ~ "Medium",
                              f2_nocomp[common] >= 0.02 ~ "Small",
                              TRUE ~ "Negligible")
  ) %>% arrange(desc(pmax(f2_with, f2_without)))
}
f2_table1 <- build_f2_table(get_f2_tol(pls_comp),  get_f2_tol(pls_nocomp))
f2_table2 <- build_f2_table(get_f2_tol(pls_comp2), get_f2_tol(pls_nocomp2))
```

## HTMT Check per Group (MGA Prerequisite)

```{r table-htmt}
htmt_comp   <- get_htmt_tol(pls_comp)
htmt_nocomp <- get_htmt_tol(pls_nocomp)

if (!is.null(htmt_comp) && !is.null(htmt_nocomp)) {
  htmt_combined <- full_join(htmt_comp, htmt_nocomp,
                              by = "From", suffix = c("_With","_Without")) %>%
    select(From, Tolerance_With, Flag_With, Tolerance_Without, Flag_Without) %>%
    rename("Construct"      = From,
           "HTMT (With)"    = Tolerance_With,
           "Flag (With)"    = Flag_With,
           "HTMT (Without)" = Tolerance_Without,
           "Flag (Without)" = Flag_Without)
  htmt_combined %>%
    kable(align = "lrlrl") %>%
    kable_styling(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE,
                  bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
    row_spec(which(htmt_combined$`Flag (With)` != "OK (<0.85)" |
                   htmt_combined$`Flag (Without)` != "OK (<0.85)"),
             bold = TRUE, color = "#c0392b")
}
```

## MGA 1 — Bootstrap Paths per Group

```{r table-mga1-comp}
build_path_table <- function(boot_sum, group_label, n) {
  df <- as.data.frame(boot_sum$bootstrapped_paths)
  df$Path <- rownames(df)
  df_tol <- df %>%
    filter(grepl("->  Tolerance", Path)) %>%
    mutate(
      From     = str_replace(Path, "  ->  Tolerance", ""),
      Original = round(`Original Est.`, 3),
      CI_low   = round(`2.5% CI`, 3),
      CI_high  = round(`97.5% CI`, 3),
      P_val    = `Bootstrap P Val`,
      Sig      = case_when(P_val < 0.001 ~ "***",
                            P_val < 0.01  ~ "**",
                            P_val < 0.05  ~ "*",
                            TRUE          ~ "n.s."),
      Significant = P_val < 0.05
    ) %>%
    select(From, Original, CI_low, CI_high, P_val, Sig, Significant)

  df_tol %>%
    select(-Significant) %>%
    mutate(P_val = round(P_val, 3)) %>%
    rename("Predictor" = From, "β" = Original,
           "2.5% CI" = CI_low, "97.5% CI" = CI_high,
           "p-value" = P_val, "Sig." = Sig) %>%
    kable(align = "lrrrrl",
          caption = paste0(group_label, " (n = ", n, ") — Paths → Tolerance")) %>%
    kable_styling(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE,
                  bootstrap_options = c("bordered","condensed")) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
    row_spec(which(df_tol$Significant), bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
}

build_path_table(boot_comp_sum,  "With Compensation",    n_comp)
```

```{r table-r2-mga}
  Model = c("MGA 1 — Full","MGA 1 — Full","MGA 2 — No Socio","MGA 2 — No Socio"),
  Group = c(paste0("With Compensation (n=",    n_comp,   ")"),

                   pls_nocomp2$rSquared["Rsq", "Tolerance"]), 3),
  AdjR2 = round(c(pls_comp$rSquared["AdjRsq",    "Tolerance"],

) %>%

  kable(align = "llrr") %>%
```
